body:
All I can say is my experience was truly nuts. I've tried a lot of drugs but none have affected me as heavily as DXM. My first experience was very extreme including extreme body euphoria and stimulation similar to MDMA as well as a very emotional increase in my way of thinking. I also experienced the 'outside of the box' thinking and a tendency to studder when speaking, probably just me being nervous. Overall, a great experience.
